name: opennexus-web
description: OpenNexus in the browser: the interactive viewer (M43), the viewer site (M44) and what grows from them.

scripts.build: npm run build -w viewer-core && npm run build -w viewer-app && npm run build -w obsidian
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p viewer-core --noEmit && tsc -p viewer-app --noEmit && tsc -p obsidian --noEmit && tsc -p e2e --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build -w viewer-app && npm run build -w obsidian && npm run fixtures && npm run e2e
scripts.vectors: NEXUS_WRITE_VECTORS=1 vitest run viewer-app/test/sealed.test.ts && cd .. && NEXUS_WRITE_VECTORS=1 swift test --filter SealedTests
